english_title: Proposition 2.2: Caratheodory Criterion for Borel Measures on Metric Spaces
statement_en: Let $\mu$ be an outer measure on a metric space $(X,d)$. If $\mu$ satisfies that for any two sets $A,B$ with positive distance, $\operatorname{dist}(A,B)>0$, one has $$\mu(A\cup B)=\mu(A)+\mu(B),$$ then this defines a Borel measure.
callout_body: $\mu$是度量空间$(X,d)$上定义的外测度，如果$\mu$满足，对任意的距离大于0的两个集合$A,B$($\text{dist}(A,B)>0$)都有$$\mu(A\cup B)=\mu(A)+\mu(B)$$那么这是一个Borel测度。
